responsibility: Stores the process `argc`, `argv`, and `envp` values in module-local globals and exposes simple accessors so other GNU Modula-2 runtime modules can query the command line and environment. It also registers itself with `M2RTS` so the arguments are captured during module initialization.
same_name_distinction: Stores argc, argv, and envp in module-local globals and registers the module with M2RTS so they are captured at initialization time, whereas gcc/m2/pge-boot/GUnixArgs.h only declares the accessor functions.
